root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `exif_mnote_data_apple_identify()` may compare `e->data` against `"Apple iOS"`, it must establish that the MakerNote payload spans at least `strlen("Apple iOS") + 1` bytes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the Apple MakerNote identify site with `e->size == 2` and still executes the string comparison. The missing size guard lets `strcmp` treat a short heap buffer as a NUL-terminated string; the fixed code restores the source-level bound check before the compare.

nodes.state: The Apple MakerNote comparison site executes with `e->size` smaller than `strlen("Apple iOS") + 1`, so the sink treats a short MakerNote heap buffer as a full C string.
After MakerNote lookup succeeds, `interpret_maker_note()` forwards the same parsed MakerNote payload pointer into the Apple-identify call site.
The EXIF parser materializes the MakerNote `ExifEntry` with `entry->size` smaller than `strlen("Apple iOS") + 1`.

edges.relation: The same MakerNote payload pointer forwarded at the Apple-dispatch call site becomes `e->data` inside `exif_mnote_data_apple_identify()`.
The MakerNote payload pointer copied into the parsed `ExifEntry` is later recovered from `ExifData` and reaches the Apple MakerNote identify call site as `e->data`.
